notes: Starting cards as posted under =STARTING=: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can, Dagobah, Prepared Defenses (dested Heading For The Medical Frigate), Wise Advice, Allegations of Corruption, The Way Of Things; these count toward the total.
Posted 'Prepared Defenses' (a Dark interrupt) on this Light list dested Heading For The Medical Frigate, the Light starting interrupt (as in earlier DeckTech rulings).
Posted 'Allegations of Corruption' is a Dark-only card (no Light printing), so it is printed as written.

Posted 'Degobah ...' sites dested the Dagobah: sites; 'Luke's Pack' dested Luke's Backpack (the strategy calls it Luke's Backpack); 'Qui-Gon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn; 'Houjix/Out Of Somewhere' dested Houjix & Out Of Nowhere; 'Jedi Resilience' dested A Jedi's Resilience. 'C ndros' dested Kal'Falnl C'ndros (the strategy's 'Cndros' who zeroes the opponent's battle destiny); 'Padme' dested Padme Naberrie; 'Jar Jar' dested Jar Jar Binks; 'Out Of Commission Combo' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated.
Posted 'JT 1-6' dested the six Jedi Tests: Great Warrior, A Jedi's Strength, Domain Of Evil, Size Matters Not, It Is The Future You See, You Must Confront Vader.
The list as posted totals 57 cards, not 60; kept as published. The strategy also mentions Reactor Terminal, which is not in the list.
The byline 'Silver "Slides_Rule" Dragoon' reads as a fictional name (the Silver Dragoon of The Legend of Dragoon), so the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle Slides_Rule with no player page.
